exposure: increased cefazolin dose based on BMI (3 g dose for BMI ≥ 30)
cohort: 2231 women who underwent caesarean section in 2014 and 2015 at Wellington Hospital
finding: Maternal obesity (BMI ≥ 30) was significantly associated with increased risk of surgical site infection (SSI) after caesarean section.
mod_finding: This study found that maternal obesity was the biggest risk factor for surgical site infection after a cesarean section.
